verdict.rationale: Virtual or headless display creation is a fair question for a remote-desktop host like AnyDesk, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions virtual displays, headless rendering, or keeping a covered window rendering. The CLI, REST API and community items cover other topics, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
